quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: operating revenue RMB 14,376,889,476.95, up 56.92% from RMB 9,162,148,135.92; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,544,890,905.62 (+31.79%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 2,304,668,898.50 (+26.92%); operating cash flow RMB 2,096,939,063.47 (+114.61%). The company attributes the growth to the explosion of AI compute and digital-infrastructure upgrades lifting market demand, wider product adoption and a rising domestic share. High-end processor revenue RMB 14,361,846,484.49 (+57.23%) at a 57.78% gross margin, down 5.92 percentage points. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 2,400,148,814.98, Q2 RMB 3,064,086,242.17, Q3 RMB 4,025,739,773.97, Q4 RMB 4,886,914,645.83; Q4 net profit RMB 583,444,466.10.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Costs and supply (2025 annual report): operating cost rose 82.40% to RMB 6,062,959,699.77; the company says price increases in upstream raw materials and memory auxiliary materials raised unit purchase costs, and tight packaging and test capacity at its contract manufacturers pushed up processing fees. Direct materials RMB 2,611,861,795.42 (+125.95%, 43.08% of cost); packaging and test RMB 1,233,074,923.62 (+45.20%). Prepayments rose 132.62% to RMB 2,885,125,277.48 on long raw-material purchase cycles and further strategic stocking (the top five prepayment counterparties held 85.04%); inventory book value RMB 640,606.31 ten-thousand (17.98% of total assets). Under its 'capacity planning, semi-finished goods stocking' strategy it sets production plans about 6 months ahead; the high-end processor production-to-sales ratio was 98.84% (+23.49 points).
quarterly_data.figure: operating cost RMB 6,062,959,699.77 (+82.40%); prepayments RMB 2,885,125,277.48 (+132.62%); production-to-sales ratio 98.84%

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers took RMB 1,297,987.34 ten-thousand, 90.28% of 2025 sales; names not disclosed. The largest customer, a related party, took RMB 814,909.46 ten-thousand (56.68% of sales) - the company says it bought sharply more for a special project, taking it above 50% of sales; the others took 14.04%, 8.46%, 6.13% and 4.96%. The second and fifth customers are server makers that switched from distribution to direct purchasing as volumes grew and are new to the top five. Direct sales RMB 13,734,659,952.00 (+76.79%, 58.12% gross margin); distribution RMB 627,186,532.49 (-54.99%) as distributor-served customers that reached the direct-customer threshold switched to direct.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D investment RMB 4,568,552,721.28 in 2025 (+32.58%), 31.78% of revenue, 9.26% capitalised; R&D staff 2,766 (82.99% of employees), up 28.23%. Main projects in development: a new-generation Hygon general-purpose processor (RMB 1,788,903,899.31 spent in 2025), the next-generation general-purpose processor (RMB 772,776,512.17), coprocessor (DCU) new-technology research (RMB 713,524,260.45) and a new-type processor chip (RMB 306,912,222.40). The three IPO-funded R&D projects - new-generation general-purpose processor, new-generation coprocessor and an advanced processor technology R&D center - reached their intended usable state in September 2025.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In September 2025 Hygon released the HSL (Hygon System Link) system bus interconnect protocol, opening the bus protocol, IP reference designs and its instruction set so xPU, IO, OS and OEM makers can tightly couple with Hygon CPUs; during 2025 it also released and fully opened an upgraded DCU software stack supporting supernodes and distributed training and inference. At end-2025 Hygon DCUs were deployed in 20+ key industries and 300+ application scenarios, serving the State Taxation Administration, the General Administration of Customs, local governments, several state-owned banks, the three telecom operators and internet companies; 365 mainstream large models (including DeepSeek, Qwen3, ChatGPT, Hunyuan and Zhipu) had been adapted and jointly tuned; its ecosystem alliance had 6,000+ partners and had completed 15,000+ hardware and software tests.
quarterly_data.figure: HSL released September 2025; DCU in 20+ industries and 300+ scenarios; 365 models adapted

quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business plan (company guidance, 2025 annual report): keep a 'sell one generation, validate one, develop one' strategy, raise R&D intensity, pre-research next-generation products and launch better-performing, lower-power CPU and DCU products at an appropriate time; work with leading domestic server makers on servers and workstations for general computing, AI training and edge inference; in AI, build 'Hygon DCU + industry application' full-stack solutions on its DTK software stack.
